about.headline: Hi, I'm Sasha.
paragraphs: Hi, I’m Sasha, an Australian living in Wales, a mental health nurse, lifelong reader, artist, and bookstragrammer @sashabookandbrush. My interests have always been rooted in creativity, storytelling and the things that inspire me, and this website is a place to bring those passions together.

Reading has always been an important part of my life, with a particular love for fantasy, romantasy, romance and historical fiction. I enjoy immersive worlds, complex characters and stories that stay with me long after the final page. Alongside reading for pleasure, I also read advance reader copies (ARCs), sharing reviews, recommendations and honest thoughts on upcoming releases. I love discovering new authors, exploring different genres and connecting with other readers through a shared appreciation for books.

Art has been part of my life since childhood and remains an important part of who I am. I draw inspiration from nature, mythology, fantasy and literature, exploring how colour, atmosphere and storytelling can come together through painting. My work is an ongoing exploration of ideas, techniques and creative expression, with a particular interest in bringing the worlds and feelings that inspire me into my own art.

This website is a space for me to delve a little deeper into the things I love, beyond what social media allows. I want to share more detailed book reviews and recommendations, explore my artistic process, and talk about the tools, materials and techniques I use in my work. Whether it’s sharing my thoughts on a recent read, documenting the journey behind a painting or discussing the products and tools that help bring my ideas to life, this is a place to explore my interests in more detail, share what I learn along the way and connect with others who share the same passions.

art.headline: Paintings & the kit
art.lede: The other half of the name. Work on the easel, and the paints, brushes, and paper that actually get used. Most of it is just to look at. Only originals marked for sale get a buy button — fan pieces stay on the wall.
art.suppliesLede: Same idea as the books: these are the supplies that earn a spot next to the TBR pile. Affiliate links help keep the studio stocked.

recommendations.headline: All recommendations
recommendations.lede: Every book here is one I've actually read and rated. Browse by series or five-star loves, or search the full shelf.

workIntro: If your book would actually live on my nightstand — romantasy, pretty editions, something I'd press into a friend's hands — I'd love to hear from you. DMs on Instagram; that's the inbox I actually see.

work.headline: If I'd lend it to a friend,
work.lede: I’m Sasha, an Australian book lover and artist based in Wales, sharing my passion for reading, creativity and all things bookish. Through my website and social media, I create content featuring book reviews, ARCs, reading recommendations and art inspired by the stories I love. I’m always interested in connecting with authors, publishers and brands who share my interests and would love to explore opportunities to work together.
work.packagesHeadline: A few ways it can look
work.packagesLede: These are starting points, not a menu I recite. Tell me the book and we'll shape it around what actually suits.
work.pricesNote: I don't put prices on the internet. Slide into @sashabookandbrush and we'll figure out what fits.
work.closeLede: If a title belongs on these shelves, I'd rather hear about it in a DM than a cold pitch deck. Bring the book. I'll bring the nook, the Kindle, and probably a cat in the background.

offers.title: Early copies
offers.desc: I’m always excited to discover new books and work with authors and publishers to share upcoming releases with my audience. I welcome ARC opportunities across fantasy, romantasy, romance and historical fiction, as well as other genres that catch my interest. I aim to provide honest, thoughtful reviews and engaging bookish content to help introduce readers to new stories and authors. If you’re interested in working together, I’d love to hear from you!

offers.title: Content Collaborations
offers.desc: I’m open to collaborating with authors, publishers and brands to create engaging Instagram content that showcases books, products and creative projects. From dedicated posts and reels to stories and bookish features, I love finding ways to share the things I’m passionate about with my audience. If you’re looking to promote an upcoming release, showcase a product or explore a creative partnership, I’d love to hear your ideas and discuss how we could work together.

offers.title: Gifted Collaborations
offers.desc: I love discovering new bookish products, creative tools and unique finds that inspire my reading and art. I’m always happy to hear from brands and small businesses interested in gifting opportunities, particularly those aligned with my interests in books, fantasy, art and creativity. If you think your products would be a good fit for my content, I’d love to connect and learn more about what you do.

packages.title: A few Stories

packages.title: A Reel and Stories

packages.title: The full sit-down
packages.desc: Feed post, Reel, Stories, and a note on this site so it lives somewhere quieter than the algorithm.

credentials.title: Also
credentials.org: ARC reader and Rattle the Stars PR influencer — a fancy way of saying I get books early, and I still only post the ones I'd recommend to a friend.

shop.headline: The Shop
shop.lede: Reading trackers, TBR templates, and maybe a print or two from the easel. Check back soon — or leave your email and I'll let you know when the first pieces are live.
